data.description: You can choose to make a free combat maneuver check with a successful attack. If successful, this check pulls a creature closer. This ability only works on creatures of a size equal to or smaller than you. Creatures pulled in this way do not provoke attacks of opportunity and stop if the pull would move them into a solid object or creature.
